asked.item: No 'choose platforms' step before AI writes
How to ask for one Facebook post and one LinkedIn post

verdict.reason: The FAQ says platform selection happens in the chat prompt when generating, and gives an example prompt naming LinkedIn and Facebook.

steps.text: There is no separate "select platforms" step before generating; when generating, name the platforms in your chat prompt.
For example: "Using my context, create one LinkedIn post and one Facebook post." Blotato generates one draft per platform you ask for.
When scheduling, open the draft post, select your social accounts in the Schedule panel on the right side of the screen, then click Schedule.
